title: Rime Fell: the first job's walk
intro: The career's first job in Rime (plant the survey kit at the observatory, up_the_fell), then on to the nearest way out, the saddle: 936 m in all, in the valley's reference weather (snow above the line). Walked by the procedure in `docs/craft/WALK_REVIEW.md`; shots from `walk.stills`, stops from `stops.json`.

s01.vista: Wet moor, a boulder, roofs and the water tower's lamp in the mist.
s01.discover: Side: houses on the rise, the tower.
s01.for: The drop: a village up ahead.

s02.vista: A house with shutters close on the right, longer roofs on the rise.
s02.discover: Side: the house's front and the station's long roof.

s03.vista: The valley station's long roof on the rise, the lorry road and the lane parting.
s03.discover: Side: the station's end, the water tower beyond.
s03.for: Two ways shown, the station the one to take.

s04.vista: The valley station square on the rise, its veranda and windows.
s04.for: The funicular's foot: where you're going is up.

s05.vista: The funicular's rails and steps straight up the fell, a chimney on the skyline.
s05.discover: Side: the valley station below, its lamp.
s05.for: The climb begins, with the line drawn for you.

s06.vista: Up the rails, a car stopped halfway, buildings on the top.
s06.for: A long climb with a goal at the top.

s07.vista: The rails onto the snow line, the top station's roofs, the chimney.
s07.discover: Side: the chimney with its lamp.
s07.for: Snow begins: the valley changes under you.

s08.vista: The rails through a snow cutting to the top station.
s08.discover: Side: a snow bank, the chimney over it.
s08.for: Nearly up; the cutting frames the top.

s09.vista: Coldharbour: the chimney, a hut, rocks in the snow, roofs beyond.
s09.discover: Side: the top station, its steps and lamp.
s09.for: Topping out: a village on the fell.

s10.vista: A brick house's corner close, others across the snow.

s11.vista: A trodden way over the snow, a boulder, nothing else.
s11.discover: Side: the chimney and Coldharbour's houses.
s11.for: Leaving the village: the side view has it all, ahead is white.

s12.vista: White slope, a fence far off. No subject.
s12.discover: Side: the chimney and the houses behind.
s12.for: A fork with nothing down either way.

s13.vista: White slope, a lamp on a hut on the skyline.
s13.discover: Side: the village again, a woodpile.
s13.for: The hut's lamp is all there is.

s14.vista: White, a woodpile and the snow survey hut's lamp.
s14.discover: Side: the survey hut, black on the snow.
s14.for: The hut is a stop; the way on is white.

s15.vista: White, the survey hut on its stilts far ahead.
s15.discover: Side: the survey hut behind, the chimney.

s16.discover: Side: the avalanche watch tower and its lamp.
s16.for: A fork in a white field.

s17.vista: White, rocks, a green lamp faint on the skyline.
s17.for: The beacon of the col, far: the only lead.

s18.discover: Side: a hut and rocks toward the col.
s18.for: Dead: 200 m of white since Coldharbour.

s19.vista: A big boulder close, a fence line, an animal crossing the snow.
s19.discover: Side: a boulder, the col's hut and tower.
s19.for: Something alive at last; the fence leads on.

s20.vista: The fence line, rocks, a hut and the col's green lamp.
s20.discover: Side: the col's tower far off.
s20.for: The col's beacon in sight; the way home is plain.

s21.vista: A hut and the beacon by the fence, a boulder near.
s21.for: The miners' path and the saddle track part here.

s22.vista: The beacon and the fence, rocks.
s22.discover: Side: the hut's door and steps.
s22.for: Past the col toward the saddle.

s23.for: The observatory path leaves into white.

s24.vista: A boulder, a hut far off, the observatory's lamp.
s24.discover: Side: the saddle's beacon by its hut.
s24.for: The job's lamp on the skyline: the goal, at last.

s25.vista: The observatory's block and mast on the rise, boulders.

s26.vista: The observatory square on the crest, its mast and windows.
s26.for: A good reveal: the job stands on the fell's top.

s27.vista: Arriving, you face a dark wall a metre off, its door to the right.
s27.for: 'You're there' as a wall in your face: the job's point is on the building's corner.

s28.vista: White, the fence and the saddle's beacon far off.
s28.discover: Side: the observatory behind, its mast.

s29.vista: The fence line to the beacon and its hut.

s30.vista: The green beacon close, the hut by the fence.

s31.vista: The saddle's hut and its door.

notes: A great first third: the station, the funicular climb into the snow and Coldharbour at the top.
Dead stretch (s11 to s18, 360 to 560 m): 200 m of white slope after Coldharbour, the forks with nothing down them; a hut lamp now and then is all. The longest dead stretch of any valley.
A wall in your face (s27): the observatory's job point stands on its corner; the reveal from the crest (s26) is the job's real frame.
The way to the job is long (812 m): a newcomer's first Rime job is the walk.

fixes.title: 1. The observatory's arrival (s27)
fixes.what: The job's point is the building (the kit is planted inside), so it stays; what changed is how you meet it. The observatory turned so its door faces the way up from the saddle (rot 160 to 55), and a job in a building is now framed 20 m out as you come up to it (scripts/walk_stops.py), not at its wall. You arrive facing the observatory square on the summit, its door ahead.

fixes.title: 2. Waymarks over the white (s11 to s18)
fixes.what: After Coldharbour, 200 m of snow with nothing to steer by. The col track now has a signpost at Coldharbour's fork (the col and the observatory; refuge halfway), cairns beside the track, a refuge hut halfway, and a second signpost at the col fork. They help, but at this range they're specks: the stretch wants a line of snow poles, one every 20 m, which is a new prefab (asked of Models).
